# ⚡ Vortex Recon (v6.0)

**Zero-dependency, An Advance level browser-context attack surface mapping and live cloud root auditing via a single bookmarklet.**

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-v6.0-388bfd?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/)
[![Runtime](https://img.shields.io/badge/runtime-Vanilla_JS_(ES2022)-f7df1e?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-238636?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)

Vortex Recon executes directly inside the active browser tab context to extract endpoints, analyze production JavaScript bundles, enumerate GraphQL operations, identify dangerous DOM sinks, and verify cloud storage ACLs (AWS S3, GCP, Azure Blob, Firebase, Supabase, Cloudflare R2) without external CLI dependencies.

🔗 **Live Interactive Installer:** (https://afzal-alf4.github.io/vortex-recon/)

---

## Why Browser-Context Recon?

Traditional CLI crawlers (`katana`, `gau`, `waybackurls`) operate outside the authenticated browser session and frequently miss dynamically hydrated routes or trigger WAF/bot challenges. Running recon directly inside the DOM provides distinct operational advantages:

* **Authenticated Session Inheritance:** Automatically leverages the active tab's cookies, `Authorization` headers, and session state without manual token extraction.
* **Post-Hydration DOM Visibility:** Captures routes, `data-*` attributes, and state objects (`__NEXT_DATA__`, `__NUXT__`, Performance Resource Timing logs) *after* client-side rendering completes.
* **WAF & TLS Fingerprint Evasion:** Requests originate from the user's native browser network stack, avoiding headless browser signatures and JA3/JA4 blocks.
* **Zero Setup Overhead:** No Python environments, Go binaries, or proxy certificates required. Runs natively on any desktop browser.
* **Active Cloud Root Verification:** Automatically normalizes discovered cloud URIs (`s3://`, `gs://`, Firebase, Azure containers) and probes root listing / `.json` endpoints for public read access (`200 OK` vs `403 AccessDenied`).

---

## Core Capabilities (18-Tab Dashboard)

| Module | What It Extracts & Audits |
| :--- | :--- |
| **All Endpoints** | Normalized relative and absolute paths across DOM, scripts, and network logs |
| **Files / DB / Backups** | `.env`, `.sql`, `.bak`, `.zip`, `.git`, `.swp`, config dumps, and archive artifacts |
| **API / Dynamic** | REST (`/v1/`, `/api/`), `/wp-json`, `/graphql`, webhooks, and legacy server scripts |
| **SSRF / Redirect** | Query parameters matching open-redirect and SSRF patterns (`?url=`, `?next=`, `?redirect_uri=`) |
| **Admin / Auth** | High-value administrative, SSO, actuator, swagger, and debug routes |
| **Cloud & Buckets** | Live root ACL checks for S3, GCS, Azure Blob, Firebase (`.json`), Supabase, and R2 |
| **GraphQL** | Extracted `query`, `mutation`, `subscription` identifiers and `operationName` definitions |
| **Source Maps** | Explicit `sourceMappingURL` directives and candidate `.js.map` paths |
| **Sinks & WebSockets** | `ws://`/`wss://` endpoints, `postMessage` listeners, `eval()`, `innerHTML`, and `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` |
| **HTML Comments** | Developer notes (`<!-- TODO/FIXME -->`), staging URLs, and commented-out paths |
| **Discovery** | Live probes against `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, `security.txt`, `swagger.json`, and `openid-configuration` |
| **Headers & CSP** | Passive HTTP response header inspection, cloud backend signatures, and CSP domain extraction |
| **Param Wordlist** | Deduplicated query keys, form inputs, and `dataset` keys ready for fuzzing |

---

## Installation

### Method 1: Drag-and-Drop (Recommended)
1. Enable your browser's Bookmarks Bar (`Ctrl+Shift+B` on Windows/Linux or `Cmd+Shift+B` on macOS).
2. Visit the **[Live Installer Page](https://afzal-alf4.github.io/vortex-recon/)** and drag the **⚡ Vortex Recon v6.0** button directly onto your Bookmarks Bar.

### Method 2: Manual Setup
1. Copy the raw bookmarklet payload from [`recon.bookmarklet.js`](#raw-bookmarklet-payload) below.
2. Right-click your browser's Bookmarks Bar and select **Add Page...** (or **Add Bookmark...**).
3. Set the **Name** to `⚡ Vortex Recon v6` and paste the copied `javascript:(async()=>{...})();` string into the **URL** field.

---

## Usage Workflow

1. Navigate to your target web application in Chrome, Brave, Edge, or Firefox.
2. Click **⚡ Vortex Recon v6** on your Bookmarks Bar.
   * *Note: If prompted, allow popups for the origin so the dashboard can render in an isolated tab.*
3. Wait 3–8 seconds while the 10-stage pipeline parses DOM nodes, fetches same-origin JS bundles, and tests discovered cloud roots.
4. Use the interactive dashboard to:
   * Filter findings in real time (e.g., `OPEN`, `.json`, `s3`, `admin`, `?url=`).
   * Toggle between **Relative Paths** (for fuzzing wordlists) and **Full URLs**.
   * **Copy Visible** items directly to the clipboard or export structured reports via **Download .txt** / **Export Full .json**.
